summary.content:
Today's selection covers 85 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 59 on Artificial Intelligence and 13 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Graduates are managing AI - but are they learning much else?
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Germany Busts 'Crime-as-a-Service' Investment Fraud Outfit
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BBC Technology, NY Times Tech, Dark Reading, The Verge, BleepingComputer and others
• **Fresh Content**: 61 articles published in the last 24 hours
